# dacapo transcription data

Source: https://github.com/ya-luotao/dacapo
Pinned revision: 25754560a496c2beea3c81d72a389fb33fd7e930
Copyright (c) 2026 The dacapo authors. MIT; see LICENSE.

Only data, provenance documents and notices are included. No upstream builder,
installer, runtime implementation or test program is imported or executed.
manifest.json records the original paths and SHA-256 digests of unmodified files.
The JSON benchmark alongside this directory is derived by our own data importer.

Underlying editions and digit transcriptions are documented in
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md and scripts/scales/hanon/README.md. Hanon: G. Schirmer,
New York, n.d. [1900], plate 15538, IMSLP #91547. The ten teaching pieces retain
edition, editor, source URL and MIT encoding rights in each MusicXML header.
Hanon's D-major LH suspected engraving slip, uncertain readings, inferred digits
and compound editorial substitutions are not silently converted into gold labels.

The source MusicXML/JSON is retained for auditing and reproducible conversion.
Read .py paths mentioned by upstream documentation only as provenance references;
those external programs are neither present here nor required by our checks.
